scope: POT 1.0.2 source and complete installed closure; Kith enrollment, encrypted secret storage, browser/API verification, malformed input, guessing limits and replay/timing characteristics. This is a source/behavior review, not certification or an advisory exception.

confirmed_findings.observed: POT valid_token/2 accepts only binary terms. Kith forwarded non-binary JSON second-factor values without guards. Integer/list/map/nil inputs raise FunctionClauseError; actual browser/API tests reproduce request exceptions. Recovery fallback also accepts unguarded terms into PBKDF2 verification.
confirmed_findings.impact: Malformed second-factor requests can fail as server errors after first-factor proof. No authentication bypass demonstrated.
confirmed_findings.required_narrow_fix: Reject invalid code/secret shape before POT, handle malformed stored Base32 safely, guard recovery-code shape; preserve valid binary recovery codes and existing window.
confirmed_findings.final_fix_status: Verified by coordinator full ExUnit/browser/Redis/production checks; see pot-reviewed-validation.json

confirmed_findings.observed: Browser verification had only the browser pipeline; a signed challenge remains valid five minutes and repeated verification did not consume a guessing budget. Password-login10/min applies only to the initial password request. API authentication has an existing20/min/IP budget but no shared per-user second-factor budget.
confirmed_findings.impact: A party with valid first-factor proof can make repeated TOTP guesses; multi-IP API attempts bypass an IP-only budget. No brute-force account takeover demonstrated.
confirmed_findings.required_narrow_fix: Separate browser-second-factor10/min/IP counter plus a shared browser/API10/min/user budget, preserving initial password budget and API20/min/IP. Revalidate real transport peer identity and ignore forged address headers.
confirmed_findings.final_fix_status: Verified by coordinator full ExUnit/browser/Redis/production checks; see pot-reviewed-validation.json

confirmed_findings.observed: Both code inputs had the same name/id and remained enabled/required. Actual OTP form posted [valid OTP, empty string]; valid recovery form failed native validation on the hidden OTP input.
confirmed_findings.fix: Disable the inactive input and assign a unique recovery input id; preserve existing CSRF and authentication/window semantics.
confirmed_findings.final_fix_status: Both focused browser cases pass; full23browser tests pass; actual posted values and recovery consumption/reuse verified.

unchanged_security_behaviors.observed: addwindow:1 shifts the reference interval forward by30s; window:1 then accepts counters current,current+1,current+2. Previous interval is rejected. The previous Accounts doc description was inaccurate.
unchanged_security_behaviors.deterministic_coverage: Fixed timestamps immediately before/after a step boundary plus a contemporary fixed epoch, compared to independent HMAC reference.
unchanged_security_behaviors.decision: Preserve window; changing it requires a separately explicit behavior decision.

unchanged_security_behaviors.observed: POT primitive is stateless; repeated valid-token checks return true. Kith has no persisted accepted-counter or consumed challenge state. RFC6238 one-time-use guidance is not implemented by this integration.
unchanged_security_behaviors.classification: Known unchanged application-level replay limitation; not a newly introduced POT-upgrade defect and not a demonstrated authentication bypass.
unchanged_security_behaviors.decision: No replay/storage/authentication rewrite in this bounded task. Do not claim replay protection is present.

unchanged_security_behaviors.observed: POT compares generated token binaries using Erlang pattern equality and exits on the first matching candidate. There is no documented constant-time token comparison guarantee.
unchanged_security_behaviors.classification: Defense-in-depth gap. No statistical timing experiment or remote exploit was performed; source equality alone does not establish an exploitable timing channel.
unchanged_security_behaviors.decision: Report accurately; no ad-hoc cryptographic rewrite or claim of constant-time behavior.

unchanged_security_behaviors.observed: POT can raise for invalid Base32 characters or unpadded input producing a non-byte-aligned bitstring. Empty keys are accepted by HMAC itself. Current Kith-generated secrets are always20byte/32character Base32, so these decoder limitations do not break generated/stored secrets.
unchanged_security_behaviors.decision: Constrain/fail-closed at Kith boundary; preserve valid padded/lowercase encodings and existing encrypted secret format.

unchanged_security_behaviors.observed: TOTP user field uses Kith.EncryptedBinary, AES256GCM with its own AAD and SECRET_KEY_BASE-derived key. It does not use the Cloak-compatible credential vault format.
unchanged_security_behaviors.decision: Preserve existing format and key source; no secret migration.
